queue.headline: GTA 6 Easter Eggs: Fast & Furious Car, Dexter's Apartment
queue.full_caption:
Leonida is packed with pop culture nods 🎬

Players have already spotted a Fast and Furious car, Dexter's apartment and an X-Men parody comic. They're early finds, and the world looks full of film and TV references.

Which Easter egg are you hunting for first?

Source: GamesRadar+

#GTA6 #GrandTheftAuto6 #GTAVI #Leonida #RockstarGames #EasterEggs #ViceCity #GTACommunity #Gaming #GamingNews
queue.alt_text: Graphic with the headline about GTA 6 movie and TV Easter eggs, including a Fast and Furious car and Dexter's apartment.

slides.title: Brian's Eclipse is in the game
slides.text: Players can get Brian O'Conner's 1995 Mitsubishi Eclipse from Fast and Furious. Head to Vespucci Island and break into a garage for a chance to claim it, with no upgrade needed.

slides.title: Dexter's apartment
slides.text: A complex on Washington Island holds Dexter's apartment. Look on the roof of the building and you can find the weapons he's known for.

slides.title: An X-Men parody comic
slides.text: Pick up an issue of 'RX Men' and you'll meet Dr. Placebo, a character who looks a lot like Magneto. It's one of several Marvel-style nods in Leonida.

slides.title: Early days for the hunt
slides.text: These are only the first discoveries, and the world is full of pop culture surprises. Expect the community to keep finding more.

queue.headline: GTA 6's PS5 Trigger Trick Makes Cruising Effortless
queue.full_caption:
Cruising in GTA 6 just got a lot more relaxed on PS5. 🎮

Rockstar uses the DualSense adaptive triggers to give the throttle a gentle soft stop when you hit the speed limit. Rest your finger on it and cruise, or push through when you want to go faster. Polygon's writer loves it.

Do you cruise or floor it everywhere?

Source: Polygon

#GTA6 #GrandTheftAuto6 #GTAVI #RockstarGames #PS5 #DualSense #AdaptiveTriggers #Leonida #OpenWorld #GTANews
queue.alt_text: Graphic with the headline about GTA 6's PS5 adaptive trigger feature that makes cruising at the speed limit easier.

slides.title: The Soft Stop
slides.text: On the PS5 version of GTA 6, the right trigger (your throttle) pushes back gently when you reach the speed limit while driving.

slides.title: Cruising Made Easy
slides.text: You can rest your finger on that resistance the way you'd rest a foot on a real pedal. No more hovering and tweaking to match the speed of traffic.

slides.title: Push Past It
slides.text: When you want speed, pressing through the soft stop feels satisfying. Polygon compares it to a kickdown in an automatic car, with the vehicle surging forward.

slides.title: A DualSense Perk
slides.text: Because the effect relies on adaptive triggers, it's a PS5 feature. Xbox controllers don't have adaptive triggers.

queue.headline: GTA 6 Exotic Animals Front: Find the Parrot's Cash Stash
queue.full_caption:
A chatty parrot just handed you an easy payday in Leonida. 🦜

Behind the Three Sheets Liquor Store in Key Lento, there's a guarded exotic bird smuggling operation. Clear out the guards, ask the parrot about the cash, and you'll walk away with $1,263 from a hidden stash. Swipe for the full walkthrough.

Will you sneak in with bottle distractions or go in loud?

Source: GamesRadar+

#GTA6 #GTAVI #GrandTheftAutoVI #RockstarGames #Leonida #KeyLento #GTA6Guide #GTA6Tips #GamingNews #VideoGames
queue.alt_text: Graphic for a GTA 6 guide about the Exotic Animals Front illegal operation, showing a parrot hinting at a hidden cash stash in Key Lento.

slides.title: Where to find it
slides.text: The operation sits behind the Three Sheets Liquor Store in Key Lento, just north of the Pay N'Spray. Climb the fence to the left of the store (facing it) to reach the walled-off area.

slides.title: Deal with the guards
slides.text: Five or six armed criminals patrol the area. Lure them out one by one with the scattered bottles and take them down quietly. Going in guns blazing adds to a violent criminal profile and brings the cops.

slides.title: Ask the parrot
slides.text: Talk to the parrot in the cage and pick 'Cash?', then 'Where's the cash?'. It points you to the generator in the corner, straight ahead and to the left as you face the parrot.

slides.title: Grab the $1,263
slides.text: Open the white vent next to the generator to find $1,263. A nearby door leads to more cash in a safe and counting machine, plus one more guy. You can also study the birds to add them to your collection.
